title: Leave Policy
content: Employees are entitled to 20 paid leaves annually. Sick leave requires medical proof if exceeding 2 days.

title: Work From Home Policy
content: Employees can work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval.

title: IT Security Guidelines
content: Do not share passwords. Use VPN for remote access. Report phishing emails immediately.

title: Expense Reimbursement
content: All expenses must be submitted within 30 days with valid receipts.

title: Code of Conduct
content: Employees must maintain professionalism, respect colleagues, and follow company ethics.

title: Laptop Usage Policy
content: Company laptops must not be used for personal downloads or unauthorized software.

title: Attendance Policy
content: Employees must log attendance daily in the system before 10 AM.

title: Data Privacy Policy
content: Sensitive company data must not be shared externally without approval.

title: Travel Policy
content: Travel must be pre-approved and booked via company portals.

title: Performance Review
content: Performance reviews are conducted twice a year.
